# monotaur_calendar_event (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur calendar event: a time-bounded, labelled annotation such as a deployment, release, change or holiday, recorded to give context to status history. Calendar events do not affect monitoring, alarms or uptime; for planned downtime use `monotaur_maintenance_window`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_label" "release" {
  text = "change::release"
}

# A deployment recorded alongside status history. Labels are linked from the
# event; do not also list the event in monotaur_label.calendar_event_ids.
resource "monotaur_calendar_event" "release_4_2" {
  title              = "Release 4.2"
  description        = "Rolled out to all regions"
  external_reference = "CHG-1234"
  start_date_time    = "2030-03-14T22:00:00+01:00"
  end_date_time      = "2030-03-14T22:45:00+01:00"
  label_ids          = [monotaur_label.release.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_date_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the event ends. Must not be before `start_date_time`; equal to it for a point-in-time event.
- `start_date_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the event starts, e.g. `2030-01-01T22:00:00Z`. The API stores it in UTC; any offset may be used and is kept as written while the instant is unchanged.
- `title` (String) The title of the event (1 to 250 characters, at least one letter). Need not be unique.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A longer description of the event (at most 1000 characters). Removing it from the configuration clears it.
- `external_reference` (String) A reference to an external record such as a ticket, change request or release (at most 250 characters, not required to be unique). Removing it from the configuration clears it.
- `label_ids` (List of String) IDs of labels attached to the event. Set to `[]` to remove all; leave unset to leave the links unmanaged. Do not also manage the same links with `monotaur_label.calendar_event_ids`. Deleting a label removes it from its events.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the event was created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the calendar event (assigned by the API).
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the event was last updated (assigned by the API).
